title: The Impact of Inference Acceleration on Bias of LLMs
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype detection related to religion, as part of a broader analysis of demographic bias.
findings: The paper evaluated stereotypical bias related to religion using the CrowSPairs and DT-Stereotyping datasets as one of several demographic categories. The results for the religion category (REL) in the CrowSPairs benchmark showed only minor and inconsistent changes in bias scores across different models and inference acceleration strategies. The paper did not highlight any specific, significant findings unique to religion, instead concluding more broadly that the effects of inference acceleration on bias are complex, unpredictable, and vary by model and strategy.
